'''R4-M1''' was an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] that was present inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] were trapped on the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] at [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] rushed into the [[Temple]] to play their distress message, jostling the R4 unit as he sped past. It was seen with [[R5-S9/Legends|R5-S9]]. It was later seen aboard [[Wolffe's Acclamator-class assault ship/Legends|CC-3636's transport]] during the [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|Mission to Aleen]] and then on [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|Adi Gallia's flagship]] during the [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Battle of Patitite Pattuna]], and was able to escape the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] before it exploded.
